title: Terraform GRE tunnel, static IP, VPN credential and location resources

checks.do: Whether a static IP with `geo_override = true` supplies coordinates or leaves them to the API.
Whether a location carries IP addresses or VPN credentials, and for a sub-location IP addresses.

gre-vips-auto-selected.statement: If `primary_dest_vip` and `secondary_dest_vip` are not set, the provider queries the Zscaler cloud for the GRE tunnel's primary and secondary destination datacenter and VIP; the blocks can override this.

quotes: The provider automatically query the Zscaler cloud for the primary and secondary destination datacenter and virtual IP address (VIP) of the GRE tunnel.

gre-vip-one-attribute.statement: Within a destination VIP block only one of `datacenter` and `virtual_ip` is required; given a datacenter name such as YVR1 the provider selects the available VIP.

quotes: The provider will automatically select the available VIP.

static-ip-coordinates-optional.statement: `latitude` and `longitude` on a static IP are optional and computed; when not provided the API determines them from the IP address.

quotes: Latitude with 7 digit precision after decimal point, ranges between -90 and 90 degrees. If not provided, the API will automatically determine it from the IP address.

static-ip-v4-6-2-auto-coordinates.statement: Since provider v4.6.2 the static IP resource determines coordinates automatically when `geo_override = true` but none are given, which removed the "Missing geo Coordinates" API error.

quotes: to auto-determine latitude and longitude coordinates when `geo_override = true` but coordinates are not explicitly provided, eliminating "Missing geo Coordinates" API error

static-ip-geo-override-wording.statement: The provider describes `geo_override` as: if not set, coordinates and city are determined from the IP address; otherwise the latitude and longitude must be provided.

quotes: If not set, geographic coordinates and city are automatically determined from the IP address. Otherwise, the latitude and longitude coordinates must be provided.

vpn-credential-psk-omitted.statement: The `pre_shared_key` is omitted from the output for security reasons.

quotes: The `pre_shared_key` parameter is ommitted from the output for security reasons.

location-ip-or-vpn.statement: The provider documents `ip_addresses` as required if `vpn_credentials` are not defined and `vpn_credentials` as required if `ip_addresses` are not defined; the schema marks both Optional, so the either-or rule is documentation, not a plan-time validation.

quotes: The value is required if `vpn_credentials` are not defined.
The value is required if `ip_addresses` are not defined.

sub-location-needs-ips.statement: Creating a sub-location (a non-zero `parent_id`) fails when `ip_addresses` is empty.

quotes: when the location is a sub-location ip_addresses must not be empty: %v
